subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical Chinese locale IDs from `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` to `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publish metadata, generated artifacts, and saved preferences?
rationale: The rename is semantically reasonable, but it changes public locale values and persisted state across several stable or generated surfaces, so automation should not choose the long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated assets, tests, docs, and saved preferences together with explicit compatibility handling.

options.title: Keep current region IDs
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's stable public locale IDs and continue improving terminology under those identifiers.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Keep this issue as backlog until maintainers settle the long-term localization and docs publishing contract.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated assets, tests, docs, and saved preferences together with explicit compatibility handling.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses setup, docs publishing, generated i18n, and Control UI contract surfaces recently touched in Peter's area history.
